name: Han Do-yoon
source:
Do-yoon Han is a bassist of an indie band called  'Masquerade', but he advanced to the qualifiers alone. He appears to be a sharp, cold traitor on-air but in reality, he shows concern for others. He is stressed by the misnomer traitor and tries to avoid it. Fellow contestants that know his real personality assume that there must be some underlying story, but criticism from viewers and social media grows stronger. 

Mid-season voting results: 4th place.

[Edited from English Official website]
